rows.line: It identifies the causal mechanism (multiplicative structure → Euler product → confinement) and confirms it through the controlled removal of that mechanism. But converting this causal identification into a proof requires showing that the mechanism is sufficient, not merely necessary.
rows.needle: It identifies the causal mechanism (multiplicative structure → Euler product → confinement) and confirms it through the controlled removal of that mechanism.
rows.wide: and confirms it through the controlled removal of that mechanism.
rows.new: It removes one structure, the Euler product, and the zeros leave the line; in each family tested the two go together. What is proved is this much: an absolutely convergent Euler product excludes zeros in Re s > 1; the control's coefficients are not multiplicative; and its arithmetic side is negative at a test function in classK, the last two compiled (THE_EPSTEIN_CONTROL_OBJECT v0.2 §6, §8). Converting the observation into a proof requires showing that the product is sufficient to hold the zeros to the line; the experiment shows neither that nor that it is necessary.
